Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, C.K. THAKKER
Bihar Finance Act, 1981-Section 3-Bihar Entry of Goods into Local Areas for Consumption, Use or Sale Therein Act, 1993-Section 3-Sales tax-Levy of-By Notification liability to pay tax under Finance Act exempted to the extent tax paid under Entry Tax Act-Demand of tax by Revenue denying adjustment due to exemption-High Court upheld the demand-On appeal , held: Assessee was entitled to reduction to the extent of tax paid under Entry Tax Act in view of the Notification-It was liable to pay tax but for the exemption-Liability to pay tax and actual payment of tax are conceptually
Decision Date : 29-09-2004 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1488/2004 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
